feedback: Tested output at different frequencies with a multimeter (7.8 mega-ohm input impedance). Best results are at 5-10 MHz: we're measure 0.716 V, which means that charge pump output is about 4.3V.

Starts reacting a tad around 3kHz, goes up nicely to about 1MHz at which point it'll still creep up but less and less.  Tops out around 38MHz then starts falling, but only loses 10-20mV by the time its reached 60MHz
